The public North team cheat sheet also lists Thea as QFL's main contact. I also told Ilse that Dana is our account manager for QFL, so Dana is the one to ask where the issue stands.

I didn't find anything showing whether the door 6 issue was fixed. I also didn't mention any seat counts or contract details in the reply.
